descriptive_title: Grade 1 Mathematics: Demonstrations — Canadian Coins and Bills (F1.1)
short_description: A 5-day Grade 1 unit on Canadian money framed around Penny the Penguin Shopkeeper and Coin Cassie the Cashier. Children identify 6 coins and 4 bills, compare values, and buy in a market.
long_description: Penny the Penguin Shopkeeper and Coin Cassie the Cashier run our Classroom Market! This 5-day Ontario-aligned Grade 1 unit covers F1.1. Day 1 introduces 4 coins (nickel, dime, quarter, 50¢). Day 2 adds LOONIE ($1) and TOONIE ($2). Day 3 introduces BILLS ($5, $10, $20). Day 4 adds $50 and compares values with MORE/LESS/EQUAL. Day 5 closes with a Big Market Capstone where children buy and sell. Includes 5 lesson plans with expanded walkthroughs (each tackling a Grade-1 trap: size-vs-value, value-jump, colour confusion, count-vs-value, overpay), 5 student worksheets, 12 paper manipulatives, formative + reflection sheets, full assessment suite, and Junior Shopper G1 certificates.
target_buyer: Ontario Grade 1 teachers looking for a fully scaffolded 5-day money unit (F1.1).
subject: Mathematics
pedagogical_approach: Hands-on Canadian money exploration with character-driven market frame, structured pair work, and progression from coin to bill to comparison to purchase.
